description: Device validation registry - tracks workbench validation status for each device

test_signal.validation_notes: Utility signal generator for testing - not a historical device emulation. Generates standard test patterns (ramps, colorbars, checkerboard, oscillators).

paik_abe_colorizer.validation_notes: RECLASSIFIED AS PROTOTYPE: Triangle wave folding approach is NOT authentic to Paik/Abe schematics. Actual Paik/Abe uses CA3019 amplitude windows (PED Control, Page 28). This module is an artistic interpretation - valuable for creative use but not historically accurate. See: research/prototypes/paik_abe_colorizer_v1/spec.json

paik_abe_input_matrix.validation_notes: VALIDATED - CA3054 soft limiting produces pastel colors, RGB mix controls work, rotation provides subtle cross-channel modulation

paik_abe_folding_amp.validation_notes: RECLASSIFIED AS PROTOTYPE: No 'folding amplifier' exists in actual Paik/Abe schematics. The real colorization uses CA3019 amplitude windows (PED Control, Page 28). This wavefolder is a creative tool inspired by audio synthesis concepts (Serge/Buchla). See: research/prototypes/paik_abe_folding_amp_v1/spec.json

authenticity.notes: Useful for video waveshaping effects, just not authentic to Paik/Abe

paik_abe_ped_colorizer.validation_notes: VALIDATED - Classic Paik/Abe 4-window colorization (blue→magenta→yellow→cyan), CA3019 amplitude detection working, softness controls edge transitions

paik_abe_output_encoder.validation_notes: VALIDATED - LM741 rail saturation (87% limit), warmth shifts color temperature, thermal drift modeling working

minimum_tests: parameter_sweep - Sweep each parameter through full range
required_artifacts: At least 2 screenshots showing device behavior
Parameter sweep GIF for primary parameter
documentation: Reference to source schematic or spec
Notes on any deviations from original
